units.title: Verify: defaultArtPaths unit tests for game/public/assets

tests.name: defaultArtPaths resolves manifest and assets root from the script dir
tests.title: defaultArtPaths resolves manifest and assets root from the script dir
tests.scenario: Given the script dir /repo/game/frontend/scripts, when defaultArtPaths is called, then the manifest is /repo/game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json and the assets root is /repo/game/public/assets
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateArtScript.test.ts --testTimeout=20000
tests.detail: Updated expectations to game/public/assets; passes against defaultArtPaths in game/frontend/scripts/generateArt.ts.

tests.name: runGenerateArt writes every binary entry with identical bytes on the second run
tests.title: writes every binary entry with identical bytes on the second run
tests.scenario: Given runGenerateArt is run twice on the same input, when the second run completes, then every binary entry has identical bytes
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateArtScript.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: runGenerateArt declares dimensions equal to the PNG header of each ART_SOURCES file and ends with a newline
tests.title: declares dimensions equal to the PNG header of each ART_SOURCES file and ends with a newline
tests.scenario: Given runGenerateArt writes the manifest, when it completes, then each entry's dimensions equal the PNG header of its source file and the manifest ends with a newline
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateArtScript.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: registers art:generate as vite-node scripts/generateArt.ts
tests.title: registers art:generate as vite-node scripts/generateArt.ts
tests.scenario: Given package.json is read, when its scripts are checked, then art:generate is registered as vite-node scripts/generateArt.ts
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateArtScript.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: rewrites the worlds/the-boys-room manifest and writes every PNG under public/assets
tests.title: rewrites the worlds/the-boys-room manifest and writes every PNG under public/assets
tests.scenario: Given createFsIo over a mocked fs, when the manifest is read and rewritten, then every PNG is written under the assets root
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateArtScript.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: throws when the manifest is missing and does not replace it with an empty one
tests.title: throws when the manifest is missing and does not replace it with an empty one
tests.scenario: Given a mocked fs whose manifest read fails with ENOENT, when the manifest is read, then it throws and nothing is written
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/generateArtScript.test.ts --testTimeout=20000
